name: Kikou Sentai Edelstein
original_name: 輝光戦隊エーデルシュタイン
source:
The protagonist meets a well-known senior at the high school he enrolls in.
He's not particularly good-looking, and in fact, his white coat and glasses give him a strange aura.
For some reason, this senior is the object of admiration from the female students.
According to his friends, he's a world-class genius.
Without warning, the senior taps the protagonist on the shoulder.
And then he says just this:

"Would you like to be my pink?"

"Yes?"

From that day on, evil fighters appear, ignoring the protagonist's wishes, and the protagonist is inevitably drawn into daily battles.

[Roughly translated from the[url=http://junoju.my.coocan.jp/juno/kikakusitu/edel/edel00.htm] Official Website.[/url]]
